reviews.comment: Funny how one of the options here to describe this professor as "online savvy" when she is definitely not the best fit for teaching an online course. She will absolutely help you when you have questions but be prepared to ask a lot of questions. This class was by far the most disorganized and confusing course I have ever taken. She is caring though
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: People had several complaints about this professor throughout the semester, but I actually really enjoyed her. Although somewhat sporadic, her lectures were always interesting. Although project instructions were sometimes unclear, she will work with you if you ask questions. She cares about your grades! Exams are not difficult if you study.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects

reviews.comment: This class was, to say the least extremely disorganized, vague, and confusing. Questions on exams and assignments are worded weirdly and not easy to understand. Even if the exams are open books and notes, exams are hard and confusing. Sometimes she was even disorganized during lectures. Instructions for projects and assignments were confusing.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I could not fit any more in-person classes into my schedule. Naturally, I thought an online class would work. The class was 100% online with no set times or dates...that is until Professor Foster decided there were. If you are looking for an easy class to work at your own pace, this is not it. Very disorganized and confused by Canvas.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I'm not sure she knows what she's doing day to day. She flip flops on instructions often and even her TAs are confused. If you go to class you'll do fine on exams but assignments make no sense regardless.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Class is so disorganized. Instructions are never clear and you mostly just hope that what you are doing is correct. Her syllabus was never updated. 15% of our grade was supposed to be 6 perusals yet she has only posted 1 for the year, not sure what is going to make up that 15%. 1 group project, 1 individual project, weekly quizzes and 3 exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Foster is a sweet but she is extremely disorganized. Her instructions are never clearly explained and her syllabus was never updated. 15% of the grade consisted of 6 Perusals but yet she has only posted 1 for the whole year. There are 3 exams, 1 group project, 1 individual project, and weekly quizzes. Quizzes are doable, exams hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Foster is really sweet, but her tests are impossible. I showed up to every lecture and took notes, but still struggled on the exams. The lectures are also pretty hard to sit through; not much of the content she discusses is also on the slides and she has a very soft voice, so it's hard to hear her.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Foster is a sweet professor, but I would never take her again. There is only two exams, two papers, and a group project. I did well on the papers and project, however, did not do the best on the tests resulting in a B for the course. She also graded the assignments on the day grades were due, so I didn't know my grades till the last minute.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Foster is very nice and I enjoyed her lectures. 2 tests and 2 papers and 1 group project. Tests were not hard if you study & attend lecture.

Dr. Foster is so sweet, but she's a horrible professor. Her lectures don't make any sense, and her slides don't help at all. This course only has two exams, a group project, and a final paper. I was completely lost all semester, and most people I talked to felt the same way. DON'T TAKE THIS CLASS
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: There's only 4 grades, so if you do poorly on the second exam (like I did), then its impossible to pull it back up. She's a caring lady & loves what she teaches. However, the second exam was so rough, it completely tanked my grade. I wouldn't recommend her class at all, as my grade doesn't nearly reflect the amount of effort I put into this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Holly Foster's lectures reminds me of high school presentations . All she does is read of the slides and then adds comments about BLM. She lacks any form of in-depth knowledge about the field of Criminology. Don't buy the textbook, waste of money. Test are ridiculously easy if you study the slides. You can't hear her ever. DO NOT TAKE THIS.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took this class because it sounded fun because the rate my prof reviews weren't horrible. I stand corrected. This class was the bane of my existence. She is not a good lecturer, the exams aren't open book, the slides are hard to understand even with her lectures. She does give a study guide but even if you take notes in class it wont help.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Foster is sweet but I didn't like her class. Her voice is very soft and doesn't seem to know her material extremely well - takes a lot of pauses. Her PPTs are super vague and does not give much information. Even though tests were open note, I struggled and ended up getting Bs. A lot of reading but some test questions come from offhand comments
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Foster is really passionate about her research and the field of criminology as a whole. Her lectures can be monotone but honestly that's just her voice. Exams are open note and pretty fair. She posts her lecture slides but you have to go to class to understand them fully. I loved her class and plan to take her Spring class next semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected

reviews.comment: super sweet and the material is SO interesting. there are weekly quizzes but theyre pretty straightforward if you read/watch the material. she gathers material from a bunch of sources so its kind of hard to gather it all together, but its all super important and relevant. really understanding when i spoke to her outside of class. take her!
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Though Dr. Foster may be monotone she is a great professor and knows a lot about what she teaches. You need to pay attention to lectures and stay on top of your work or you will struggle in the class. A lot of writings and readings but very intrestings.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Foster is very nice and knowledgeable, however as the common trend in her reviews depicts, she gives fairly boring lectures, exacerbated by her tonality, verbal filler words, and technological incompetency. Taking her online this semester contributed to these issues, however her vast expertise in the subject is useless if not properly taught.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is the worst professor I've taken at A&M. Her lectures are boring and uninteresting. Her quizzes are supposed to help you but often times just hurt your grade. Questions sometimes have multiple answers and she has to regrade the quiz. She knows a lot about the subject, she just isn't an effective teacher and your GPA will possibly suffer.

She is very blunt and reads off the lecture slides but expects you to know everything deeper rather than helping you succeed and know the material. Her voice is so monotone & says um so often that I lose track of what shes saying. Do not recommend taking her class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Foster is nice and very smart, but her lectures are really boring. She doesn't post notes online, but gives study guides for every test that are usually on quizlet. 304 is tests only, really easy. Crime & Gender is 2 papers 3 tests, pretty easy too. Her exams aren't cumulative and the textbook isn't necessary. I've taken her twice now, easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Foster was a great prof, though her lectures were a little bland because she speaks very monotone. However, she had tones of useful information, gave a study guide before the exams, and was generally encouraging. If you read the text books, then you don't have to go to class ever(personal experience) otherwise I would go to class. I'd take again.
reviews.ratingTags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Foster is a wonderful teacher. She's incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about her field. We had two papers and two tests. Pay attention in class. She is very understanding about students' busy lives and will help you out when you need it. Class is lecture heavy, but the lectures are very appropriate. She brings guest lecturers in often.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She does read right off the slides like people have said before, but she is obviously an expert in her field and I felt like that showed when she answered questions. If you study for the tests you'll be fine, I felt like it was a pretty easy A. Clicker questions are a part of your grade for the class so attendance is mandatory.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Foster made me dread going to class. She'a very monotone and reads off her PowerPoint slides which doesn't make the course the least bit interesting. Definitely made an interesting subject boring. Would not recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Foster!  She is kind of monotone, but she is very knowledgeable and passionate about the subject matter.  I'm taking her Crime in the Life Course this fall.

I really enjoyed her class! She is a bit monotone, but honestly everything that you need to know for the tests are on the powerpoint slides. She gives you a study guide before the exam that basically is the exam. If you miss class though, I wouldn't count on her putting the notes online. Really though, the material is easy and she is very nice.

She's very monotone and doesn't really engage with the students. She doesn't post lectures online, so you have to go to class if you want the material for the review. She seems like a nice lady, but she just isn't interesting.

I felt like I was watching a high school student present a project everyday. Never went into any depth during the lectures, she just read straight off the powerpoints with a soft voice that would put anyone to sleep. She seems to have no enthusiasm about the class and made the coolest subject the most boring class I have ever taken. Hard tests!
I do well with how she teaches. Learned a lot. Good class.
